rules.rule_name: Program Initialization - Clear Working Storage
rules.rule_description: At program startup, all working storage fields including queue names and message fields are cleared to ensure no residual data affects processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
1: Program Initialization
Initialize working storage fields,
clear queue names and message fields

acceptance_criteria.Given: The account inquiry service program is triggered to start
acceptance_criteria.When: The program begins execution
acceptance_criteria.Then: All queue name fields (Input Queue Name, Queue Manager Name), message fields (Queue Message), and error display fields are cleared to spaces and initialized to their default empty values before any processing begins

rules.rule_name: Error Queue Setup - Open CARD.DEMO.ERROR for Writing
rules.rule_description: Before any business processing begins, the dedicated error queue must be opened for output so that any subsequent errors can be captured and routed appropriately.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
2: Error Queue Setup
Open CARD.DEMO.ERROR queue
for writing error messages

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has completed initialization of working storage fields
acceptance_criteria.When: The program attempts to open the error queue named 'CARD.DEMO.ERROR' for writing
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the error queue opens successfully, the error queue handle is saved and the error queue status is marked as open, allowing subsequent error messages to be written to 'CARD.DEMO.ERROR'; if the error queue fails to open, the error details are displayed and the program terminates immediately

rules.rule_name: Transaction Trigger Retrieval - Retrieve CICS Trigger Message
rules.rule_description: The program retrieves the CICS trigger message that initiated this transaction. The trigger message contains the name of the input queue to process.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
3: Transaction Trigger Retrieval
Retrieve triggering transaction
info from CICS

acceptance_criteria.Given: The error queue has been successfully opened and the program is ready to identify its input source
acceptance_criteria.When: The program retrieves the CICS trigger message
acceptance_criteria.Then: The trigger message data (MQTM) is retrieved and made available for extracting the input queue name; if retrieval fails, the CICS response codes are captured and an error message is composed containing 'CICS RETREIVE' as the error paragraph identifier along with the response codes, the error is sent to the error queue, and the program terminates

rules.rule_name: CICS Retrieve Failure - Terminate with Error
rules.rule_description: If the CICS trigger message cannot be retrieved, an error notification is sent to the error queue and the program terminates without processing any account inquiries.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
16: Error Notification
Send error details to error queue

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program attempted to retrieve the CICS trigger message
acceptance_criteria.When: The CICS RETRIEVE command does not return a NORMAL response
acceptance_criteria.Then: The error paragraph is identified as 'CICS RETREIVE', the CICS response codes (RESP1 and RESP2) are formatted into an error message prefixed with 'RESP: ', the error message is written to the 'CARD.DEMO.ERROR' queue, and the program proceeds to termination closing all open queues

rules.rule_name: Input Queue Identification - Extract Queue Name and Set Reply Queue
rules.rule_description: Upon successful trigger message retrieval, the input queue name is dynamically extracted from the trigger message, and the reply queue is set to the fixed destination 'CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT'.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
4: Input Queue Identification
Extract input queue name from trigger
Set reply queue to CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT

acceptance_criteria.Given: The CICS trigger message has been successfully retrieved
acceptance_criteria.When: The program processes the trigger message content
acceptance_criteria.Then: The input queue name is set to the queue name extracted from the trigger message field MQTM-QNAME, and the reply queue name is set to the hardcoded value 'CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT'

rules.rule_name: Input Queue Open - Open Account Inquiry Request Queue for Shared Reading
rules.rule_description: The input queue identified from the trigger message is opened in shared read mode so that account inquiry request messages can be retrieved for processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
5: Input Queue Open
Open input queue in shared
read mode to receive messages

acceptance_criteria.Given: The input queue name has been identified from the trigger message
acceptance_criteria.When: The program opens the input queue for reading
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the input queue opens successfully, the input queue handle is saved and the reply queue status is marked as open (REPLY-QUEUE-OPEN = TRUE), enabling message retrieval; if the input queue fails to open, the queue name is recorded as 'INPUT-QUEUE-NAME', the error message 'INP MQOPEN ERR' is sent to the error queue, and the program terminates

rules.rule_name: Output Reply Queue Open - Open CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT for Writing Responses
rules.rule_description: The fixed reply queue 'CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT' is opened for writing so that account inquiry responses can be delivered back to the requesting system.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
6: Output Reply Queue Open
Open CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT
in write mode for responses

acceptance_criteria.Given: The input queue has been successfully opened and the reply queue name is set to 'CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT'
acceptance_criteria.When: The program opens the reply output queue for writing
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the reply queue opens successfully, the output queue handle is saved and the response queue status is marked as open (RESP-QUEUE-OPEN = TRUE), enabling response delivery; if the reply queue fails to open, the queue name is recorded as 'REPLY-QUEUE-NAME', the error message 'OUT MQOPEN ERR' is sent to the error queue, and the program terminates

rules.rule_name: Initial Message Retrieval - Retrieve First Message with 5-Second Wait
rules.rule_description: The program attempts to retrieve the first account inquiry request message from the input queue, waiting up to 5 seconds for a message to become available.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
7: Initial Message Retrieval
Retrieve first available message
from input queue - 5 second wait

acceptance_criteria.Given: Both the input queue and reply queue have been successfully opened
acceptance_criteria.When: The program attempts to retrieve the first message from the input queue
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program waits up to 5,000 milliseconds (5 seconds) for a message; the message ID and correlation ID are cleared before retrieval; if a message is retrieved, it is placed into the message buffer (1,000 byte buffer) and processing continues; if no message is available within 5 seconds, the NO-MORE-MSGS condition is set and the program proceeds to termination

rules.rule_name: Message Availability Check - Determine if More Messages Exist
rules.rule_description: After each message retrieval attempt, the program checks whether a message was successfully retrieved to determine if processing should continue or if the program should terminate.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
More Messages
Available?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has attempted to retrieve a message from the input queue
acceptance_criteria.When: The result of the message retrieval is evaluated
acceptance_criteria.Then: If a message was successfully retrieved (NO-MORE-MSGS is false), the program proceeds to parse and process the message; if no message was available (NO-MORE-MSGS is true), the program proceeds to close all queues and terminate

rules.rule_name: Message Processing Loop - Commit and Retrieve Next Message
rules.rule_description: After each message is processed and a reply is sent, the transaction is committed via a CICS syncpoint before retrieving the next message, ensuring each reply is permanently committed before moving on.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
8: Message Processing Loop
Commit transaction via syncpoint
and retrieve next message

acceptance_criteria.Given: A message has been processed and a reply has been sent to the reply queue
acceptance_criteria.When: The program prepares to retrieve the next message
acceptance_criteria.Then: A CICS SYNCPOINT is executed to commit the current transaction (making the reply permanent), and then the next message is retrieved from the input queue with a 5,000 millisecond wait interval; the loop continues until no more messages are available

rules.rule_name: Request Message Parsing - Extract Function Code and Account Key
rules.rule_description: Each retrieved message is parsed to extract the function code (WS-FUNC) and the account key (WS-KEY) which are the two critical fields that determine how the request will be processed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
9: Request Message Parsing
Parse incoming message to extract
function code and account key

acceptance_criteria.Given: A message has been successfully retrieved from the input queue
acceptance_criteria.When: The program parses the incoming message content
acceptance_criteria.Then: The function code (WS-FUNC) and account key (WS-KEY) are extracted from the message; these two fields are used to validate and route the request for further processing

rules.rule_name: Account Inquiry Request Validation - Function Code and Account Key Check
rules.rule_description: Every incoming request is validated to ensure it contains the correct function code 'INQA' and a non-zero account key before any account lookup is performed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Function Code = INQA
AND Account Key > 0?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A message has been parsed and the function code (WS-FUNC) and account key (WS-KEY) have been extracted
acceptance_criteria.When: The program evaluates the request validity
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the function code equals 'INQA' AND the account key is greater than zero, the request is considered valid and proceeds to account lookup; if either condition is not met (function code is not 'INQA' OR account key is zero or blank), the request is treated as invalid and an invalid request response is built

rules.rule_name: Account Inquiry Validation - Set Account ID for Lookup
rules.rule_description: When a valid INQA request is confirmed, the account key from the request message is assigned as the account ID to be used for the account file lookup.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
10: Account Inquiry Validation
Validate function code is INQA
and account ID is non-zero

acceptance_criteria.Given: The request has been validated with function code 'INQA' and account key greater than zero
acceptance_criteria.When: The program prepares for the account record lookup
acceptance_criteria.Then: The account key value (WS-KEY) is moved into the account record ID field (WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID) which will be used as the search key to read the account record from the ACCTDAT file

rules.rule_name: Account Record Lookup - Read Account from ACCTDAT by Account ID
rules.rule_description: The account record is retrieved from the ACCTDAT (Account File - VSAM) using the account ID as the unique key to fetch all account details.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
11: Account Record Lookup
Read account record from ACCTDAT
using account ID as key

acceptance_criteria.Given: A valid account inquiry request has been received with function code 'INQA' and a non-zero account ID
acceptance_criteria.When: The program reads the account record from the ACCTDAT file using the account ID (WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID-X) as the key
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the account record is found, all account fields are made available for response building; if the account is not found, an account-not-found response is prepared; if a file access error occurs, the error details are sent to the error queue and the program terminates

rules.rule_name: Account Data Response Building - Populate Full Account Details
rules.rule_description: When an account record is successfully found, all relevant account fields are extracted and assembled into the response message to be returned to the requesting system.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
12: Account Data Response Building
Populate response with account details:
ID, Status, Balance, Credit Limit,
Cash Credit Limit, Dates, Group ID

acceptance_criteria.Given: The account record has been successfully retrieved from the ACCTDAT file
acceptance_criteria.When: The program builds the account inquiry response
acceptance_criteria.Then: The following account fields are populated into the response (WS-ACCT-RESPONSE): Account ID (ACCT-ID), Account Active Status (ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS), Current Balance (ACCT-CURR-BAL), Credit Limit (ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT), Cash Credit Limit (ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT), Account Open Date (ACCT-OPEN-DATE), Account Expiration Date (ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE), Account Reissue Date (ACCT-REISSUE-DATE), Current Cycle Credits (ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT), Current Cycle Debits (ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT), and Account Group ID (ACCT-GROUP-ID); the assembled response is then moved to the reply message field

rules.rule_name: Account Not Found Response - Build Invalid Request Error for Missing Account
rules.rule_description: When the requested account ID does not exist in the account file, an error response message is constructed indicating the account was not found, and processing continues for subsequent messages.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
13: Account Not Found Response
Build error response indicating
invalid request - account ID not found

acceptance_criteria.Given: A valid INQA request was received with a non-zero account ID
acceptance_criteria.When: The account record is not found in the ACCTDAT file for the provided account ID
acceptance_criteria.Then: An error response message is built containing the text 'INVALID REQUEST PARAMETERS ACCT ID : ' followed by the account key value (WS-KEY), this message is placed into the reply message field, and the response is sent to the reply queue 'CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT'; the program continues processing subsequent messages without terminating

rules.rule_name: Invalid Request Response - Build Error for Bad Function Code or Zero Account Key
rules.rule_description: When a request fails validation because the function code is not 'INQA' or the account key is zero, an error response is built identifying both the invalid account ID and the invalid function code.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
14: Invalid Request Response
Build error response indicating
invalid request - bad function code
or zero account key

acceptance_criteria.Given: A message has been retrieved from the input queue
acceptance_criteria.When: The function code (WS-FUNC) is not equal to 'INQA' OR the account key (WS-KEY) is zero or blank
acceptance_criteria.Then: An error response message is built containing the text 'INVALID REQUEST PARAMETERS ACCT ID : ' followed by the account key value (WS-KEY) and 'FUNCTION : ' followed by the function code value (WS-FUNC), this message is placed into the reply message field, and the response is sent to the reply queue 'CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT'; the program continues processing subsequent messages without terminating

rules.rule_name: Reply Message Delivery - Send Response to CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT
rules.rule_description: All responses (successful account data, account not found, or invalid request) are delivered to the reply queue with proper message correlation so the requesting system can match the reply to its original request.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
15: Reply Message Delivery
Put account inquiry response
onto the reply queue

acceptance_criteria.Given: A response message has been built (either account data, account not found error, or invalid request error)
acceptance_criteria.When: The program sends the response to the reply queue
acceptance_criteria.Then: The reply message is placed onto the 'CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT' queue with a buffer length of 1,000 bytes, the message format is set to string format, the original message ID (SAVE-MSGID) is preserved in the message descriptor, the original correlation ID (SAVE-CORELID) is preserved to allow the requester to correlate the reply, and the message is sent within the current syncpoint scope; if the put operation fails, the error details including queue name 'REPLY-QUEUE-NAME' and message 'MQPUT ERR' are sent to the error queue and the program terminates

rules.rule_name: Input Queue Closure - Close Account Inquiry Request Queue
rules.rule_description: After all messages have been processed, the input queue is closed to release the queue resource.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
17: Input Queue Closure
Close input queue after
all messages processed

acceptance_criteria.Given: All messages have been processed from the input queue and the NO-MORE-MSGS condition is set
acceptance_criteria.When: The program initiates termination and the input queue is marked as open (REPLY-QUEUE-OPEN is TRUE)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The input queue is closed using the saved input queue handle; if closure fails, the error details including queue name and message 'MQCLOSE ERR' are recorded and the program proceeds to termination

rules.rule_name: Output Reply Queue Closure - Close CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT
rules.rule_description: After all replies have been sent and the input queue is closed, the reply output queue is closed to release the queue resource.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
18: Output Reply Queue Closure
Close reply output queue
to release resources

acceptance_criteria.Given: The input queue has been closed and the reply output queue is marked as open (RESP-QUEUE-OPEN is TRUE)
acceptance_criteria.When: The program closes the reply output queue 'CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT'
acceptance_criteria.Then: The reply queue is closed using the saved output queue handle; if closure fails, the error details including queue name and message 'MQCLOSE ERR' are recorded and the program proceeds to termination

rules.rule_name: Error Queue Closure - Close CARD.DEMO.ERROR Queue
rules.rule_description: As the final queue closure step, the error queue is closed after all other queues have been closed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
19: Error Queue Closure
Close error queue
to release resources

acceptance_criteria.Given: Both the input queue and reply queue have been closed and the error queue is marked as open (ERR-QUEUE-OPEN is TRUE)
acceptance_criteria.When: The program closes the error queue 'CARD.DEMO.ERROR'
acceptance_criteria.Then: The error queue is closed using the saved error queue handle; if closure fails, the error details including queue name and message 'MQCLOSE ERR' are sent to the error queue itself and the program proceeds to termination

rules.rule_name: Program Termination - Orderly Shutdown and Return to CICS
rules.rule_description: The program performs an orderly shutdown by closing only the queues that were successfully opened, then returns control to CICS.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
20: Program Termination
Orderly shutdown - close all
open queues and return to CICS

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has completed all message processing or encountered a terminal error condition
acceptance_criteria.When: The program initiates the termination sequence
acceptance_criteria.Then: Each queue is conditionally closed only if it was previously opened: the input queue is closed if REPLY-QUEUE-OPEN is TRUE, the reply output queue is closed if RESP-QUEUE-OPEN is TRUE, and the error queue is closed if ERR-QUEUE-OPEN is TRUE; after all open queues are closed, control is returned to CICS via EXEC CICS RETURN

rules.rule_name: Clear Input Queue Name at Program Start
rules.rule_description: At program startup, the Input Queue Name field must be cleared to blank spaces to ensure no residual or stale queue name data influences the current processing session.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Clear Input Queue Name
Set to blank spaces

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Inquiry Service program has been triggered and is starting a new processing session
acceptance_criteria.When: The program begins its initialization sequence
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Input Queue Name field must be set to blank spaces, removing any previously held or residual queue name value before the queue name is dynamically assigned from the trigger message

rules.rule_name: Clear Queue Manager Name at Program Start
rules.rule_description: At program startup, the Queue Manager Name field must be cleared to blank spaces to ensure no stale queue manager reference is carried into the current processing session.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Clear Queue Manager Name
Set to blank spaces

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Inquiry Service program has been triggered and is starting a new processing session
acceptance_criteria.When: The program begins its initialization sequence
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Queue Manager Name field must be set to blank spaces, ensuring the queue manager reference is clean and ready to be populated from the trigger message

rules.rule_name: Clear Queue Message Fields at Program Start
rules.rule_description: At program startup, the Queue Message field must be cleared to blank spaces to ensure no residual message content from a prior execution affects the current session's message processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Clear Queue Message Fields
Set to blank spaces

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Inquiry Service program has been triggered and is starting a new processing session
acceptance_criteria.When: The program begins its initialization sequence
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Queue Message field must be set to blank spaces, ensuring the message buffer is empty and ready to receive new incoming account inquiry messages

rules.rule_name: Initialize Error Display Fields at Program Start
rules.rule_description: At program startup, all error tracking and error display fields must be reset to their initial default values to ensure accurate error reporting throughout the current processing session.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Initialize Error Display Fields
Reset error tracking fields

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Inquiry Service program has been triggered and is starting a new processing session
acceptance_criteria.When: The program begins its initialization sequence
acceptance_criteria.Then: All error display and error tracking fields (MQ-ERR-DISPLAY) must be initialized to their default values, ensuring that any error information captured during the session reflects only errors from the current run and not from any prior execution

rules.rule_name: Complete Initialization Before Queue Setup
rules.rule_description: All working storage fields — including Input Queue Name, Queue Manager Name, Queue Message, and Error Display fields — must be fully cleared and initialized before the program proceeds to open any queues. This ensures a clean and consistent state for the entire processing session.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Initialize Error Display Fields
Reset error tracking fields

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Inquiry Service program has been triggered to start
acceptance_criteria.When: The program executes its startup initialization sequence
acceptance_criteria.Then: All four initialization steps must complete in the following strict order before any queue is opened: (1) Input Queue Name is set to blank spaces, (2) Queue Manager Name is set to blank spaces, (3) Queue Message field is set to blank spaces, (4) Error Display fields are initialized to default values — only after all four steps are complete does the program proceed to open the Error Queue

rules.rule_name: Error Queue Name Assignment
rules.rule_description: The error queue name is always statically assigned to 'CARD.DEMO.ERROR' as the designated destination for all system error messages. This is a fixed business configuration that does not vary by request or context.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Error Queue Name to CARD.DEMO.ERROR

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is initializing its error handling infrastructure at startup
acceptance_criteria.When: The error queue setup process begins
acceptance_criteria.Then: The error queue name must be set to the fixed value 'CARD.DEMO.ERROR', which is the sole designated queue for capturing all error messages generated during account inquiry processing

rules.rule_name: Error Queue Must Be Opened for Writing Before Processing
rules.rule_description: Before any account inquiry processing begins, the program must establish write access to the error queue 'CARD.DEMO.ERROR'. This ensures that any errors encountered during processing can be captured and routed appropriately.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Attempt to Open CARD.DEMO.ERROR Queue for Writing

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is starting up and the error queue name has been set to 'CARD.DEMO.ERROR'
acceptance_criteria.When: The program attempts to open the error queue
acceptance_criteria.Then: The error queue 'CARD.DEMO.ERROR' must be opened with output (write) access and with context-passing enabled, so that error messages can be written to it throughout the program's lifecycle; this step must complete before any other queue is opened or any message processing begins

rules.rule_name: Error Queue Successfully Opened — Mark as Ready
rules.rule_description: When the error queue 'CARD.DEMO.ERROR' is successfully opened for writing, the program records its availability status so that subsequent error-handling routines know they can safely route error messages to it.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark Error Queue as Open and Ready to Accept Error Messages

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has attempted to open the error queue 'CARD.DEMO.ERROR' for writing
acceptance_criteria.When: The queue is opened successfully without any errors

rules.rule_name: Error Queue Unavailable — Terminate Program
rules.rule_description: If the error queue 'CARD.DEMO.ERROR' cannot be opened, the program cannot safely handle any errors that may arise during processing. Therefore, the program must log the failure details and immediately terminate without processing any account inquiry messages.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has attempted to open the error queue 'CARD.DEMO.ERROR' for writing

acceptance_criteria.Then: The program must display the full error details (including queue name 'CARD.DEMO.ERROR', error condition code, and error reason code) to the system log, and then immediately terminate all processing — no input queue, output queue, or account inquiry messages may be processed under any circumstances when the error queue is unavailable

rules.rule_name: Program Termination When Error Queue Is Unavailable
rules.rule_description: The inability to open the error queue is treated as a fatal condition. The program must perform an orderly shutdown, closing any queues that were already opened, before returning control to the calling system.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Terminate Program

acceptance_criteria.Given: The error queue 'CARD.DEMO.ERROR' could not be opened and error details have been displayed to the system log
acceptance_criteria.When: The termination process is triggered due to error queue unavailability
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program must close any queues that were successfully opened prior to this failure (input queue if open, output queue if open, error queue if open), and then return control to the CICS system — no account inquiry messages are retrieved or processed

acceptance_criteria.Given: The CICS trigger message has been successfully retrieved with a NORMAL response

rules.rule_name: Set Fixed Reply Queue Destination for Account Inquiry Responses
rules.rule_description: Upon successful trigger retrieval, the reply queue where all account inquiry responses will be sent must be set to the fixed, hardcoded destination queue CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The CICS trigger message has been successfully retrieved and the input queue name has been extracted
acceptance_criteria.When: The program sets up the reply destination for account inquiry responses
acceptance_criteria.Then: The reply queue name is always set to the fixed value 'CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT', regardless of the originating request source or input queue name

rules.rule_name: Capture Error Details on Failed Trigger Retrieval
rules.rule_description: When the CICS trigger message retrieval fails, the error context must be captured including the operation name, condition code, and reason code to support error notification and diagnostics.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Capture error details: Condition Code and Reason Code

acceptance_criteria.Given: The CICS trigger message retrieval has been attempted
acceptance_criteria.When: The retrieval response is not NORMAL (retrieval failed)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The error context is captured as follows: the error paragraph name is set to 'CICS RETREIVE', the CICS condition code (WS-CICS-RESP1-CD) is moved to its display field (WS-CICS-RESP1-CD-D), the CICS reason code (WS-CICS-RESP2-CD) is retained, and an error message is constructed by concatenating 'RESP: ', the condition code display value, the reason code display value, and 'END' into the MQ-APPL-RETURN-MESSAGE field

rules.rule_name: Send Error Notification to Error Queue on Trigger Retrieval Failure
rules.rule_description: When the CICS trigger retrieval fails, the captured error details must be sent to the designated error queue (CARD.DEMO.ERROR) to notify downstream error monitoring systems.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Send error notification to error queue

acceptance_criteria.Given: The CICS trigger message retrieval has failed and the error details including condition code, reason code, and error message have been captured
acceptance_criteria.When: The error notification process is invoked (9000-ERROR)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The error details stored in MQ-ERR-DISPLAY are placed into the error message buffer and sent to the error queue CARD.DEMO.ERROR using an MQ PUT operation, so that the failure is recorded for monitoring and review

rules.rule_name: Initiate Program Termination After Trigger Retrieval Failure
rules.rule_description: After a failed CICS trigger retrieval and error notification, the program must terminate gracefully by closing all queues that were opened before ending execution, ensuring no resources are left open.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Initiate program termination and close all queues

acceptance_criteria.Given: The CICS trigger retrieval has failed and the error notification has been sent to the error queue
acceptance_criteria.When: The termination process is invoked (8000-TERMINATION)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program closes each queue that was successfully opened — the input queue (if open), the reply/output queue (if open), and the error queue (if open) — in that sequence, and then ends the CICS transaction, preventing any further account inquiry processing

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has successfully retrieved a CICS trigger message at startup containing a queue name (MQTM-QNAME)
acceptance_criteria.When: The program prepares to open the input queue for receiving account inquiry requests

rules.rule_name: Open Input Queue in Shared Read Mode
rules.rule_description: The input queue must be opened with shared read access so that the program can receive and consume incoming account inquiry request messages. The queue is opened with context-saving capability to preserve message context for reply correlation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Request to Open Input Queue in Shared Read Mode

acceptance_criteria.Given: The input queue name has been set from the trigger message and the queue manager connection is established
acceptance_criteria.When: The program requests to open the input queue for processing
acceptance_criteria.Then: The input queue is opened with shared read access (allowing multiple readers), with full message context saved (to support reply correlation), and configured to fail immediately if the queue manager is shutting down — ensuring safe and context-aware message consumption

rules.rule_name: Mark Input Queue as Open and Ready to Receive Messages
rules.rule_description: Upon successfully opening the input queue, the program registers the queue handle and marks the input queue status as open and ready, enabling subsequent message retrieval operations to proceed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark Input Queue as Open and Ready to Receive Messages

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has requested to open the input queue in shared read mode
acceptance_criteria.When: The input queue is opened successfully without any errors
acceptance_criteria.Then: The input queue handle is stored for use in subsequent message read operations, and the input queue status is marked as open and ready to receive account inquiry request messages

rules.rule_name: Record Input Queue Open Failure Details
rules.rule_description: When the input queue cannot be opened, the program captures the queue name and the associated error condition and reason details so that a meaningful error notification can be sent to the error queue for operational visibility.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has requested to open the input queue in shared read mode
acceptance_criteria.When: The input queue fails to open for any reason
acceptance_criteria.Then: The following error details are recorded: the input queue name is captured as the failing queue, the error condition code and reason code are recorded, and the error message is set to 'INP MQOPEN ERR' to identify this as an input queue open failure

rules.rule_name: Send Error Notification to Error Queue on Input Queue Open Failure
rules.rule_description: When the input queue cannot be opened, the recorded error details must be sent to the designated error queue (CARD.DEMO.ERROR) to notify operations of the failure before the program terminates.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Send Error Notification to Error Queue

acceptance_criteria.Given: The input queue has failed to open and error details including queue name, error condition, reason code, and error message 'INP MQOPEN ERR' have been recorded
acceptance_criteria.When: The program processes the input queue open failure
acceptance_criteria.Then: The error notification containing all recorded error details is sent to the error queue 'CARD.DEMO.ERROR' so that the failure is logged and visible to operations teams

rules.rule_name: Terminate Program on Input Queue Open Failure
rules.rule_description: If the input queue cannot be opened, the program cannot receive any account inquiry requests and must terminate gracefully, closing all previously opened queues before exiting.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The input queue has failed to open and the error notification has been sent to the error queue
acceptance_criteria.When: The program completes error notification for the input queue open failure
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program initiates graceful termination by closing all queues that were successfully opened prior to the failure (including the error queue), and then exits — no account inquiry processing takes place

acceptance_criteria.Then: The reply queue name must be set to the fixed value 'CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT', which is the designated destination for all account inquiry response messages

rules.rule_name: Reply Queue Opened in Write Mode for Account Inquiry Responses
rules.rule_description: The reply queue CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT must be opened in write/output mode with context passing enabled so that account inquiry response messages can be placed onto it.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Request to Open Reply Queue in Write Mode

acceptance_criteria.Given: The reply queue name has been set to 'CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT' and the queue manager connection is active
acceptance_criteria.When: The program requests to open the reply queue
acceptance_criteria.Then: The reply queue must be opened in write (output) mode with full message context passing enabled, so that response messages carry the original request context for the receiving application to correlate

rules.rule_name: Reply Queue Successfully Opened and Marked Ready
rules.rule_description: When the reply queue is successfully opened, it is marked as available and its handle is saved so that subsequent account inquiry response messages can be placed onto it.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Reply Queue Ready to Accept Account Inquiry Responses

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has requested to open the reply queue 'CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT' in write mode
acceptance_criteria.When: The reply queue opens successfully without any errors
acceptance_criteria.Then: The reply queue must be flagged as open and ready to accept account inquiry response messages, and the queue handle must be saved for use during message put operations throughout the session

rules.rule_name: Capture Error Details When Reply Queue Cannot Be Opened
rules.rule_description: When the reply queue fails to open, the system must capture the queue name, a descriptive error message, the condition code, and the reason code to provide a complete error record for diagnosis.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has requested to open the reply queue 'CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT' in write mode
acceptance_criteria.When: The reply queue fails to open for any reason
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must record all of the following error details: the queue name ('CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT'), a descriptive error message ('OUT MQOPEN ERR'), the condition code returned by the queue manager, and the reason code returned by the queue manager

rules.rule_name: Send Error Notification and Terminate When Reply Queue Cannot Be Opened
rules.rule_description: When the reply queue cannot be opened, the captured error details must be sent to the designated error queue CARD.DEMO.ERROR and the program must terminate, as no account inquiry responses can be delivered without a functioning reply queue.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Send Error Notification to CARD.DEMO.ERROR Queue

acceptance_criteria.Given: The reply queue 'CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT' has failed to open and error details including queue name, error description, condition code, and reason code have been captured
acceptance_criteria.When: The error notification process is triggered due to the reply queue open failure
acceptance_criteria.Then: The complete error details must be sent as a message to the error queue 'CARD.DEMO.ERROR', and the program must immediately terminate by closing all queues that are currently open (input queue, error queue) and ending the session — no further account inquiry processing may occur

rules.rule_name: Accept Any Message Without Filter Constraints

rules.rule_name: Set Message Buffer Capacity for Account Inquiry Requests

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Account Inquiry Request from Input Queue

acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must read the next available message from the Account Inquiry input queue using the configured parameters, capturing the message content into the 1,000-byte buffer for subsequent processing

rules.rule_name: Proceed to Message Processing When Message Successfully Retrieved

acceptance_criteria.Then: The retrieved message must be marked as ready for processing and the program must proceed to the account inquiry message processing loop to handle the request

rules.rule_name: Terminate Message Processing When No Message Available Within Wait Period

rules.rule_name: Continuous Message Processing Until Queue is Empty
rules.rule_description: The program continuously loops to process account inquiry messages from the input queue. Each iteration commits the prior transaction and attempts to retrieve the next message. The loop exits only when no more messages are available on the queue.

acceptance_criteria.Then: The program must repeatedly execute the message processing cycle — committing the current transaction, waiting for the next message, and processing it — until the NO-MORE-MSGS condition is raised, at which point the loop exits and the program proceeds to termination

rules.rule_name: Transaction Commit Before Each New Message Retrieval
rules.rule_description: At the start of each iteration of the message processing loop, the program commits all work performed in the previous cycle before attempting to retrieve the next message. acceptance_criteria.Then: A synchronization point (SYNCPOINT) must be issued to commit all work from the prior transaction cycle before any attempt is made to retrieve the next message from the input queue

rules.rule_name: Message Retrieval with 5-Second Wait Interval
rules.rule_description: When attempting to retrieve the next account inquiry message, the program waits on the input queue for up to 5 seconds. The message is read from the dynamically determined input queue using the established queue handle, with message ID and correlation ID reset to accept any available message.

acceptance_criteria.Then: The program must wait up to 5,000 milliseconds (5 seconds) for a message to become available on the input queue; the message retrieval must target the dynamically assigned input queue using its established handle, and both the message ID and correlation ID filters must be cleared so that any available message can be retrieved

rules.rule_name: Route to Account Inquiry Processing When Message is Available
rules.rule_description: When a message is successfully retrieved from the input queue within the wait interval, the program routes it to the account inquiry processing logic to validate the request, look up the account, and send a reply.

acceptance_criteria.When: A message is available and retrieved from the input queue
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program must invoke the account inquiry request processing logic (4000-PROCESS-REQUEST-REPLY) to validate the request parameters, perform the account lookup, and send the appropriate reply to the reply queue

rules.rule_name: Exit Message Processing Loop When No Messages Available
rules.rule_description: When no message is received from the input queue within the 5-second wait interval, the program recognizes that the queue is empty, sets the NO-MORE-MSGS condition, exits the processing loop, and proceeds to program termination.

acceptance_criteria.Then: The NO-MORE-MSGS condition must be set to true, causing the message processing loop to exit, and the program must proceed to the termination routine which closes all open queues (input queue, reply queue, and error queue) in sequence before ending

rules.rule_name: Loop Back to Commit After Each Successful Message Processing
rules.rule_description: After successfully processing an account inquiry message and sending the reply, the program loops back to the beginning of the message processing cycle to commit the completed transaction before attempting to retrieve the next message.

acceptance_criteria.When: The current message processing iteration completes

rules.rule_name: Reset Processing Buffers Before Message Parsing
rules.rule_description: Before processing any incoming account inquiry message, the reply message buffer and all date/time working fields must be cleared to ensure no residual data from a previous message contaminates the current processing cycle.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Clear Reply Message Buffer
Reset Date and Time Fields

acceptance_criteria.Given: A new incoming message has been received from the Input Queue and is ready for processing
acceptance_criteria.When: The program begins processing the new message
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Reply Message buffer must be cleared to spaces, and all Date and Time working fields must be reset to zeroes before any data extraction or validation begins

rules.rule_name: Extract Function Code from Incoming Request Message
rules.rule_description: The function code (WS-FUNC) must be extracted from the incoming request message to identify the type of inquiry being requested. The expected value for an account inquiry is 'INQA'.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Extract Function Code
WS-FUNC from Message

acceptance_criteria.Given: An incoming request message has been received from the Input Queue and the reply buffer has been cleared
acceptance_criteria.When: The program parses the incoming message
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Function Code field (WS-FUNC) must be extracted from the message, representing the type of operation requested (e.g., 'INQA' for Account Inquiry)

rules.rule_name: Extract Account Key from Incoming Request Message
rules.rule_description: The Account Key (WS-KEY) must be extracted from the incoming request message to identify the specific account to be queried. This key serves as the unique identifier used to look up the account record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Extract Account Key
WS-KEY from Message

acceptance_criteria.Given: An incoming request message has been received and the Function Code (WS-FUNC) has been extracted
acceptance_criteria.When: The program continues parsing the incoming message
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Account Key field (WS-KEY) must be extracted from the message, representing the unique Account ID number that identifies the account to be retrieved

rules.rule_name: Validate Function Code and Account Key Are Present and Valid
rules.rule_description: Both the Function Code and Account Key extracted from the request message must meet minimum validity criteria before account inquiry processing can proceed. The Function Code must be 'INQA' and the Account Key must be a non-zero positive value. Both conditions must be satisfied simultaneously.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Function Code
Extracted Successfully?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Function Code (WS-FUNC) and Account Key (WS-KEY) have been extracted from the incoming request message
acceptance_criteria.When: The program validates the extracted fields
acceptance_criteria.Then: Processing proceeds to Account Inquiry only if BOTH conditions are true: (1) the Function Code equals 'INQA', AND (2) the Account Key is greater than zero. If either condition fails, the request is flagged as invalid and routed to the Invalid Request Response path

rules.rule_name: Route Valid Request to Account Inquiry Processing
rules.rule_description: When both the Function Code equals 'INQA' and the Account Key is a valid non-zero value, the request is confirmed as a valid Account Inquiry and must be routed to the account lookup process.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Function Code Available
for Validation

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Function Code (WS-FUNC) has been extracted from the message and the Account Key (WS-KEY) has been extracted from the message
acceptance_criteria.When: The Function Code equals 'INQA' AND the Account Key is greater than zero
acceptance_criteria.Then: The request is recognized as a valid Account Inquiry request and processing proceeds to the Account Inquiry Validation and account file lookup stage

rules.rule_name: Flag Invalid Request and Send Error Reply When Function Code or Account Key Is Missing or Invalid
rules.rule_description: When the Function Code is not 'INQA' or the Account Key is zero or blank, the request cannot be processed as a valid account inquiry. An error reply message must be constructed containing both the invalid Account ID and the invalid Function Code, and sent back to the reply queue. Processing continues for subsequent messages.

Proceed to

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Function Code (WS-FUNC) and Account Key (WS-KEY) have been extracted from the incoming request message
acceptance_criteria.When: The Function Code does NOT equal 'INQA', OR the Account Key is zero or blank (either condition alone is sufficient to trigger this path)
acceptance_criteria.Then: An error reply message must be constructed with the text 'INVALID REQUEST PARAMETERS ACCT ID: <WS-KEY value> FUNCTION: <WS-FUNC value>' and sent to the reply queue 'CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT'. The program does not terminate and continues to process the next message in the queue

rules.rule_name: Validate Account Inquiry Function Code
rules.rule_description: The system must verify that the incoming request specifies the Account Inquiry function code 'INQA' before any account data retrieval is attempted. Requests carrying any other function code are rejected as invalid.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Function Code equal to 'INQA'?

acceptance_criteria.Given: An account inquiry request message has been received from the input queue containing a function code and an account ID
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the function code in the request
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the function code is exactly 'INQA', the request is considered valid for further processing; if the function code is anything other than 'INQA', the request is immediately rejected as invalid and an error response is prepared

rules.rule_name: Validate Account ID is Non-Zero
rules.rule_description: The system must verify that the account ID provided in the request is a non-zero positive value. A zero or blank account ID is not a valid identifier for account data retrieval.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Account ID greater than Zero?

acceptance_criteria.Given: An account inquiry request message has been received with function code 'INQA' already confirmed as valid
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the account ID value in the request
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the account ID is greater than zero, the request is considered fully valid and proceeds to account data retrieval; if the account ID is zero or blank, the request is rejected as invalid and an error response is prepared

rules.rule_name: Both Function Code and Account ID Must Be Valid to Proceed
rules.rule_description: The system enforces that both the function code equals 'INQA' AND the account ID is greater than zero must be satisfied simultaneously. If either condition fails, the request is treated as invalid and no account data retrieval is performed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Account Inquiry Validation - Validate that the request contains function code 'INQA' and a non-zero account ID key before attempting account data retrieval

acceptance_criteria.Given: An account inquiry request message has been received from the input queue containing a function code (WS-FUNC) and an account ID key (WS-KEY)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates both conditions together: function code equals 'INQA' AND account ID is greater than zero
acceptance_criteria.Then: Only when both conditions are met simultaneously does the system proceed to retrieve account data; if either the function code is not 'INQA' or the account ID is zero or blank (or both fail), the system treats the request as invalid and routes to error response building

rules.rule_name: Build Invalid Request Error Response with Received Parameters
rules.rule_description: When a request fails validation (invalid function code or zero account ID), the system constructs an error response message that echoes back the exact account ID and function code that were received in the invalid request, so the requesting system can identify what was wrong.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Build Invalid Request Response Including:
- Received Account ID
- Received Function Code

acceptance_criteria.Given: An account inquiry request has failed validation because either the function code is not 'INQA' or the account ID is zero or blank
acceptance_criteria.When: The system builds the error response message
acceptance_criteria.Then: The error response message must contain the literal text 'INVALID REQUEST PARAMETERS' followed by the label 'ACCT ID :' with the actual account ID value received in the request, and the label 'FUNCTION :' with the actual function code value received in the request, all concatenated into a single reply message

rules.rule_name: Send Invalid Request Error Response to Reply Queue
rules.rule_description: After building the invalid request error response message, the system must deliver it to the designated reply queue (CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT) so the requesting system receives notification of the invalid request. The reply is sent with the original message correlation identifiers preserved to allow the requester to match the response to their original request.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Send Error Response to Reply Queue

acceptance_criteria.Given: An invalid request error response message has been built containing the received account ID and function code
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sends the error response
acceptance_criteria.Then: The error response message is placed onto the reply queue 'CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT' with the original message ID and correlation ID from the incoming request preserved in the reply, ensuring the requesting system can correlate the error response back to its original inquiry; after successful delivery the program continues processing the next message from the input queue

rules.rule_name: Account ID Used as File Search Key
rules.rule_description: The account ID value received in the inquiry request must be set as the key used to search for the account record in the ACCTDAT file.

acceptance_criteria.Given: An account inquiry request has been received with a non-zero Account ID (WS-KEY) and a valid function code of 'INQA'
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to look up the account record in the ACCTDAT file
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Account ID from the request (WS-KEY) must be assigned as the record search key (WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID) before the file lookup is performed, ensuring the correct account record is targeted

rules.rule_name: Account Record Search in ACCTDAT File
rules.rule_description: The system must perform a direct key-based lookup of the account record from the ACCTDAT account file using the Account ID as the unique record identifier.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Search for Account Record in ACCTDAT file

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account ID has been set as the file search key and the ACCTDAT file is accessible
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes a read operation against the ACCTDAT file using the Account ID as the record key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the full account record matching the provided Account ID from the ACCTDAT file, and the search result (found or not found) is captured for subsequent processing

rules.rule_name: Account Record Search Result Decision
rules.rule_description: After searching the ACCTDAT file, the system must evaluate the search outcome and route processing to either the account data response path (if found) or the account not found response path (if not found).
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Account Record Search Result?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A search for the account record in the ACCTDAT file has been completed using the provided Account ID
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the result of the account record search
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the account record is found (search result = NORMAL), the system proceeds to retrieve all account details and build the account data response; if the account record is not found (search result = NOT FOUND), the system proceeds to prepare an account not found error response

rules.rule_name: Account Record Found - Retrieve All Account Details
rules.rule_description: When an account record is successfully located in the ACCTDAT file, all relevant account data fields must be extracted from the record and made available for building the inquiry response.

- Group ID

acceptance_criteria.Given: The account record search in the ACCTDAT file returned a successful match for the provided Account ID
acceptance_criteria.When: The system retrieves the account record data
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must extract and store all of the following account details from the retrieved record: Account ID, Account Active Status, Current Balance, Credit Limit, Cash Credit Limit, Account Open Date, Account Expiration Date, Account Reissue Date, Current Cycle Credit Balance, Current Cycle Debit Balance, and Account Group ID — and then proceed to build the account data response (Business Process 12)

rules.rule_name: Search Account Record in Account File Using Account ID

acceptance_criteria.Given: A valid account inquiry request has been received with Function Code 'INQA' and a non-zero Account ID (WS-KEY)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system searches the ACCTDAT Account File (LIT-ACCTFILENAME) using the Account ID (WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID-X) as the search key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the account record from the ACCTDAT file and evaluates the search result to determine the next course of action: Record Found, Record Not Found, or Unexpected Error

rules.rule_name: Extract and Return Full Account Details When Account Record is Found
rules.rule_description: When the account record is successfully located in the ACCTDAT file, the system extracts all relevant account details and prepares them for the response message to be sent to the reply queue.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:

Extract Account Details:
- Account ID

- Credit Limit
- Cash Credit Limit

- Expiration Date
- Reissue Date
- Current Cycle Credit Balance
- Current Cycle Debit Balance
- Group ID

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has searched the ACCTDAT Account File using the provided Account ID
acceptance_criteria.When: The search result indicates the account record was found (Normal response)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system extracts and maps the following account details into the response: Account ID (ACCT-ID), Account Active Status (ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS), Current Balance (ACCT-CURR-BAL), Credit Limit (ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT), Cash Credit Limit (ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT), Account Open Date (ACCT-OPEN-DATE), Account Expiration Date (ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE), Account Reissue Date (ACCT-REISSUE-DATE), Current Cycle Credit Balance (ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT), Current Cycle Debit Balance (ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT), and Account Group ID (ACCT-GROUP-ID), then proceeds to build and send the response message

rules.rule_name: Build Invalid Request Error Response When Account Record is Not Found
rules.rule_description: When the searched Account ID does not exist in the ACCTDAT file, the system builds an error response message indicating invalid request parameters and includes the Account ID that was not found, then sends this response to the reply queue.

acceptance_criteria.When: The search result indicates the account record was not found (Not Found response)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system builds an error response message with the text 'INVALID REQUEST PARAMETERS ACCT ID: <Account ID>' where Account ID is the value of WS-KEY that was searched, and proceeds to send this error response message to the reply queue (CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT). The program does NOT terminate and continues processing subsequent messages.

rules.rule_name: Capture Error Details and Send Error Notification on Unexpected Account File Search Failure
rules.rule_description: When an unexpected error occurs during the account file search (neither a normal result nor a not-found result), the system captures the error details including condition code, reason code, queue name, and error description, then sends an error notification to the dedicated error queue.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:

Capture Error Details:
- Condition Code
- Reason Code
- Queue Name
- Error Description

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has searched the ACCTDAT Account File using the provided Account ID
acceptance_criteria.When: The search result indicates an unexpected error (neither Normal nor Not Found response)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system captures the following error details: Condition Code (WS-RESP-CD mapped to MQ-APPL-CONDITION-CODE), Reason Code (WS-REAS-CD mapped to MQ-APPL-REASON-CODE), Queue Name (INPUT-QUEUE-NAME mapped to MQ-APPL-QUEUE-NAME), and Error Description ('ERROR WHILE READING ACCTFILE' mapped to MQ-APPL-RETURN-MESSAGE), then sends an error notification message to the error queue (CARD.DEMO.ERROR), and terminates the program

rules.rule_name: Send Error Notification Message to Error Queue on Unexpected Account File Failure
rules.rule_description: When an unexpected account file search error occurs, the system sends the captured error details as a notification message to the dedicated error queue CARD.DEMO.ERROR to ensure the error is recorded and visible for operational monitoring.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Send Error Notification
to Error Queue
CARD.DEMO.ERROR

acceptance_criteria.Given: An unexpected error has occurred during the ACCTDAT file search and error details have been captured (Condition Code, Reason Code, Queue Name, Error Description)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system invokes the error notification process (9000-ERROR) to send the error details to the error queue
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sends the error notification message (MQ-ERR-DISPLAY containing all captured error details) to the error queue CARD.DEMO.ERROR using MQPUT, and upon successful delivery proceeds to terminate the program. If the MQPUT to the error queue itself fails, the error details are written to the system display and the program terminates immediately.

rules.rule_name: Terminate Program After Sending Error Notification for Unexpected Account File Failure
rules.rule_description: After an unexpected account file search error has been logged to the error queue, the program must terminate gracefully by closing all open queues before ending execution, ensuring no further message processing occurs.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Terminate Program

acceptance_criteria.Given: An unexpected error has occurred during the ACCTDAT file search and the error notification has been sent to the error queue CARD.DEMO.ERROR
acceptance_criteria.When: The system invokes the termination process (8000-TERMINATION)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system closes all queues that were successfully opened prior to termination in the following order: (1) Input Queue if it was open, (2) Output/Reply Queue (CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT) if it was open, (3) Error Queue (CARD.DEMO.ERROR) if it was open, and then ends program execution. No further account inquiry messages are processed.

acceptance_criteria.Then: The assembled reply message must be placed onto the output reply queue (CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT) using the original message's correlation identifiers to allow the requesting system to match the response to its original inquiry request; if the message cannot be placed on the reply queue, the error details must be sent to the error queue (CARD.DEMO.ERROR) and processing must terminate

rules.rule_name: Compose Error Response Message for Account Not Found

rules.rule_name: Send Account Not Found Error Response to Reply Queue

acceptance_criteria.Then: The error response message must be placed onto the reply queue 'CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT' with a message buffer length of 1000, preserving the original message's correlation identifiers (message ID and correlation ID) so the requesting system can match the reply to its original inquiry request, and the message format is set to string type

rules.rule_name: Identify Invalid Account Inquiry Request
rules.rule_description: Validates that an incoming account inquiry request contains both a recognized function code ('INQA') and a non-zero Account ID. If either condition fails, the request is treated as invalid and an error response is triggered.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Function Code not equal to 'INQA' OR Account Key = Zero?

acceptance_criteria.Given: An account inquiry request message has been retrieved from the input queue, containing a function code (WS-FUNC) and an Account ID key (WS-KEY)
acceptance_criteria.When: The function code is NOT equal to 'INQA' OR the Account ID key is zero (or blank)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The request is classified as invalid and the program proceeds to build and send an invalid request error response; no account lookup is performed

rules.rule_name: Capture Account ID from Invalid Request
rules.rule_description: When a request is determined to be invalid, the Account ID value submitted in the request is captured so it can be included in the error response message for traceability.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Capture Received Account ID from Request Message

acceptance_criteria.Given: An account inquiry request has been identified as invalid because the function code is not 'INQA' or the Account ID is zero
acceptance_criteria.When: The program prepares the error response message
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Account ID value (WS-KEY) that was received in the request is captured and included in the error response message

rules.rule_name: Capture Function Code from Invalid Request
rules.rule_description: When a request is determined to be invalid, the function code value submitted in the request is captured so it can be included in the error response message for traceability.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Capture Received Function Code from Request Message

acceptance_criteria.Given: An account inquiry request has been identified as invalid because the function code is not 'INQA' or the Account ID is zero
acceptance_criteria.When: The program prepares the error response message
acceptance_criteria.Then: The function code value (WS-FUNC) that was received in the request is captured and included in the error response message

rules.rule_name: Build Invalid Request Error Response Message
rules.rule_description: Constructs a descriptive error response message that clearly communicates to the requesting system that the request parameters were invalid, including both the Account ID and function code that were received, to assist in diagnosing the issue.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Build Error Response Message: 'INVALID REQUEST PARAMETERS' Account ID: received account ID Function: received function code

acceptance_criteria.Given: An account inquiry request has been identified as invalid, and both the received Account ID (WS-KEY) and function code (WS-FUNC) have been captured
acceptance_criteria.When: The error response message is being built
acceptance_criteria.Then: A reply message is constructed containing the literal text 'INVALID REQUEST PARAMETERS' followed by 'ACCT ID :' and the received Account ID value, followed by 'FUNCTION :' and the received function code value, and this message is stored as the reply message (REPLY-MESSAGE) to be sent back to the requester

rules.rule_name: Send Invalid Request Error Response to Reply Queue
rules.rule_description: Delivers the constructed invalid request error response message to the designated reply queue (CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT), ensuring the requesting system receives notification that its request contained invalid parameters. The reply is correlated back to the original request using the original message identifiers.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Send Error Response to Reply Queue

acceptance_criteria.Given: An error response message has been built containing 'INVALID REQUEST PARAMETERS' with the received Account ID and function code, and the reply queue 'CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT' is open
acceptance_criteria.When: The program sends the error response
acceptance_criteria.Then: The error response message (REPLY-MESSAGE) is placed onto the reply queue 'CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT' using the original request's message ID (SAVE-MSGID) and correlation ID (SAVE-CORELID) to allow the requesting system to match the response to its original request; the message is committed as part of the current unit of work (SYNCPOINT)

rules.rule_name: Prepare Account Inquiry Response for Delivery
rules.rule_description: Before placing the response onto the reply queue, the system must load the account inquiry response content into the message buffer and attach the original request's message identifier and correlation identifier so the requesting application can match the reply to its original request.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Prepare Response Message
Load account inquiry response
into message buffer with
original message correlation details

acceptance_criteria.Given: An account inquiry response (either successful account data or an invalid request error message) has been produced and is ready to be sent back to the requesting application
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the response message for delivery to the reply queue
acceptance_criteria.Then: The response message content is loaded into the message buffer with a fixed buffer length of 1000 bytes; the original request's Message ID (SAVE-MSGID) is set as the outgoing message identifier; the original request's Correlation ID (SAVE-CORELID) is set as the outgoing correlation identifier; the message format is set to string type with the queue manager's default character set encoding

rules.rule_name: Deliver Response Message to Reply Queue Under Syncpoint Control
rules.rule_description: The prepared response message must be placed onto the designated reply queue CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT under syncpoint control, ensuring the delivery is part of the current unit of work and is only committed when the overall transaction is committed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Deliver Response to Reply Queue
Put response message onto
CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT queue
under syncpoint control

acceptance_criteria.Given: The response message buffer has been prepared with the account inquiry response content, original message correlation details, and the reply queue CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT is open for output
acceptance_criteria.When: The system delivers the response message to the reply queue
acceptance_criteria.Then: The message is placed onto the CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT queue using syncpoint control (meaning delivery is only finalised when the transaction commits), with default context propagation and with the operation set to fail immediately if the queue manager is quiescing

rules.rule_name: Confirm Successful Response Delivery
rules.rule_description: When the response message is successfully placed onto the reply queue, the system acknowledges the successful delivery and returns control to the message processing loop to handle the next incoming request.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Response Confirmed
Reply successfully placed
on queue for requesting
application to consume

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has attempted to place the account inquiry response onto the CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT reply queue
acceptance_criteria.When: The queue manager confirms the message was accepted successfully (condition code indicates OK)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The delivery outcome (condition code and reason code) is recorded, and control is returned to the message processing loop so the next incoming account inquiry request can be processed

rules.rule_name: Handle Reply Queue Delivery Failure
rules.rule_description: If the response message cannot be delivered to the reply queue for any reason, the system must log the delivery failure details to the dedicated error queue and terminate all processing to prevent data inconsistency.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
16: Error Notification
Log delivery failure details
to error queue and
terminate processing

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has attempted to place the account inquiry response onto the CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT reply queue
acceptance_criteria.When: The queue manager returns a non-successful condition code (delivery failed for any reason)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The failure condition code, reason code, and the reply queue name CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT are recorded; a delivery failure message 'MQPUT ERR' is set; the error details are written to the CARD.DEMO.ERROR error queue; and the program terminates by closing all open queues (input queue, reply queue, error queue) before ending the CICS transaction — no further account inquiry messages are processed

rules.rule_name: Format Error Message for Notification
rules.rule_description: When a processing error occurs, the system must consolidate all error details — including the error description, condition code, reason code, and the name of the queue involved — into a single formatted error message before attempting to deliver it to the error queue.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Format Error Message
Capture error details:
- Error Description
- Condition Code
- Reason Code
- Queue Name

acceptance_criteria.Given: A processing error has occurred during account inquiry processing, and the following error details have been captured: an error description (e.g., 'ERROR WHILE READING ACCTFILE', 'INP MQOPEN ERR', 'OUT MQOPEN ERR', 'MQPUT ERR', 'CICS RETREIVE'), a condition code, a reason code, and the name of the queue involved in the error
acceptance_criteria.When: The error notification process is triggered by calling the error handling routine (9000-ERROR)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must consolidate all captured error details (error description, condition code, reason code, and queue name) from the error display area into a single formatted error message buffer of 1000 characters, ready for delivery to the error queue

rules.rule_name: Send Error Message to Error Queue
rules.rule_description: The formatted error message containing all error details must be written to the dedicated error queue CARD.DEMO.ERROR so that operations and monitoring teams are alerted to the processing failure.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Send Error Message
Write formatted error message
to CARD.DEMO.ERROR queue
for monitoring and alerting

acceptance_criteria.Given: A formatted error message buffer (1000 characters) has been prepared containing the error description, condition code, reason code, and queue name, and the error queue CARD.DEMO.ERROR is open and available for writing
acceptance_criteria.When: The system attempts to write the formatted error message to the CARD.DEMO.ERROR error queue
acceptance_criteria.Then: The error message must be delivered to the CARD.DEMO.ERROR queue as a string-formatted message, ensuring the error details are available for monitoring and alerting purposes

rules.rule_name: Confirm Successful Error Message Delivery
rules.rule_description: When the error message is successfully delivered to the CARD.DEMO.ERROR queue, the system must record the successful delivery confirmation by capturing the resulting condition and reason codes, and then return control to the calling process to allow it to continue or terminate as appropriate.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Record Error Delivery Confirmation
Capture successful condition
and reason codes

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has attempted to write the formatted error message to the CARD.DEMO.ERROR queue
acceptance_criteria.When: The error message is delivered to the CARD.DEMO.ERROR queue successfully (delivery status indicates success)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must record the successful delivery confirmation by capturing the condition code and reason code returned from the delivery operation, and return control to the calling process without initiating termination

rules.rule_name: Initiate Program Termination on Error Delivery Failure
rules.rule_description: If the system is unable to deliver the error notification message to the CARD.DEMO.ERROR queue, it must capture the failure details and initiate an orderly program shutdown, as continued processing cannot be guaranteed without error visibility.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
20: Program Termination
Unable to deliver error notification
Initiate orderly shutdown

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has attempted to write the formatted error message to the CARD.DEMO.ERROR queue, and the delivery has failed (delivery status does not indicate success)
acceptance_criteria.When: The error message delivery to CARD.DEMO.ERROR fails for any reason
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) capture the failed delivery condition code and reason code, (2) record the error queue name (CARD.DEMO.ERROR) as the queue involved in the failure, (3) record 'MQPUT ERR' as the error description for the delivery failure, and (4) immediately initiate an orderly program shutdown by closing all open queues (input queue, reply queue, error queue — in that order, only if open) and ending the program
